principles.definition: A permanent academic mission (e.g. upsc_cse_prelims) represents an enduring academic curriculum and examination blueprint.
principles.proof: When a yearly cycle (rc_auth_in_upsc_cse_2026) is CLOSED or CANCELLED, the permanent mission status remains CATALOG_VISIBLE, missionId is unchanged, and all topic nodes and digibook units remain fully active.

principles.definition: A RecruitmentCycle represents a single batch or exam session with deadlines, admit cards, and results.
principles.proof: Cycles terminate upon final result declaration. Successive cycles (e.g. 2026, 2027) attach to the SAME permanent missionId without creating duplicate catalog records.

principles.definition: Occasional government recruitments without enduring syllabi can operate as standalone cycles.
principles.proof: RecruitmentCycle supports permanentMissionId = null, allowing full event reduction without requiring synthetic catalog mission generation.

verifiedByAutomatedTests: Test 1: Same permanent mission + new recruitment cycle separation (PASSED)
